name: Atelier Crenn
dinnerNote: Tasting menu; a 20% service charge and a 3% San Francisco health-care surcharge are added
dressCode: Casual-elegant; a jacket isn't required, but dressing up is encouraged.
bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable, as prepaid tickets. Dinner only.
cancellation: Bookings are final and can't be refunded, like concert tickets. To change or cancel, call or email info@ateliercrenn.com and the restaurant will try to resell your seats; if it can't, you still pay.
